steps.action: Open Compare models from the World menu, read the verdict and the arms, choose the two models' runs for the left and right sides, press Play under them and move the clock.

expect.says: The Compare view lists the comparison, opens it and shows its verdict and whom each arm decides for.
Each model's arm shows how the group fared beside what its model answered, named by the model's name, and every arm served is shown.
Two runs are drawn side by side, each with its people and how its model answered, under one clock whose Play moves the minute both are drawn at.
GET /world/versions/{version_id}/society/comparisons lists it with every run completed, and its result reads not judged because its seeds are development seeds.
The page read both runs it drew from GET /world/versions/{version_id}/society/comparisons/{comparison_id}/runs/{run_id}, which replays a run from its stored decisions and answered 200.

expect.says: The client exits 0 having read the comparison the application started, every run's outcome, and each completed model run replayed with its decisions, and its own checks hold.

steps.action: Export the run's workspace as a judge seed with the application's command (exulanica-seed export), and verify the archive against its manifest (exulanica-seed verify).

expect.says: exulanica-seed export exits 0 and writes an archive whose manifest names the run's workspace.
exulanica-seed verify re-hashes every file of the archive against its manifest and exits 0.
